_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Saying w like v, th like t, and adding i before school

items.native: w में होंठ गोल करें, v नहीं
items.gloss_en: Round your lips for w, not v.

items.native: th में जीभ दाँतों के बीच रखें
items.gloss_en: Put your tongue between your teeth for th.

items.native: शुरू में इ की आवाज़ न जोड़ें
items.gloss_en: Do not add an i sound at the start.

items.native: जीभ को मोड़ें नहीं, मसूड़ों से छुएँ
items.gloss_en: Do not curl your tongue, touch your gums.

segments.text: Four words many learners say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.hook: भारतीयों की आम ग़लती वाले 4 शब्द
native.caption: “water” को “वाटर” और “think” को “टिंक” बोलते हैं? “school” के आगे इ न जोड़ें और “doctor” में जीभ न मोड़ें। Carlos टीचर को सुनिए और ख़ामोशी में दोहराइए। Lexkite ऐप में उच्चारण का अभ्यास कीजिए।

en.caption: Do you say “water” like “vaatar” and “think” like “tink”? Do not add an i before “school” and do not curl your tongue in “doctor”. Listen to teacher Carlos and repeat in the pause. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
